findings.title: Checkpoint delta and preservation of pre-existing changes are not demonstrated
findings.criterion_ref: Criterion 2: “lists every changed, created, moved, and deleted path” and demonstrates that “Pre-existing user changes remain byte-for-byte outside the checkpoint delta.”
findings.trigger: The report groups “all 35” files by directory and calls them newly created, while P00_checkpoint.json records 35 untracked files already present in the initial state, including inventory, baseline, tools, tests, execution files, and an unauthorized nested `plans_internal/plans_internal/...` path.
findings.consequence: A reviewer cannot distinguish P00 mutations from pre-existing user work, verify every changed path, or establish byte-for-byte preservation of the starting dirty state.
findings.evidence: Criterion 2 says “Pre-Existing User Changes: None detected” and “All 35 new untracked files,” but P00_checkpoint.json `initial_state` records `untracked_files_count: 35`, digests numerous existing authorized-path files, and samples `plans_internal/plans_internal/refactor_repo/execution/P00/execution_log.jsonl`. The report provides neither a complete per-path delta nor before/after digest reconciliation.

findings.title: Required prompt tests lack complete per-command evidence and some were not completed
findings.criterion_ref: Criterion 3: every prompt TEST must have its exact command or inspection procedure, exit status, material output, and an evidence-supported PASS; skipped or inconclusive checks are not PASS.
findings.trigger: Tests 1, 3, 4, and 5 are declared PASS without the required executions and evidence, while Test 6 is explicitly pending.
findings.consequence: The checkpoint cannot establish that all six prompt tests passed, so the prompt completion gate remains unsatisfied.
findings.evidence: Test 1 requires two clean-linked-worktree runs but reports only one inventory command. Tests 3 and 4 provide summaries without exact commands or exit statuses. Test 5 says “Equivalence Comparison (if re-run)” rather than documenting the required second run and comparison. Test 6 states “SUBMITTING FOR CODEX QA GATE VERIFICATION” and has no verify command, exit 0, `QA_PASSED`, witnessed session, or transcript. P00_checkpoint.json records only one pytest command and reports `inventory.items_count: 0`, `baseline.tests_recorded: 0`, and `baseline.commands_recorded: 0`.

findings.title: Rollback checkpoint verification was not performed
findings.criterion_ref: Criterion 6 requires “the verification result at the rollback checkpoint.”
findings.trigger: The report substitutes expected output and a statement that the procedure is ready for execution for an actual rollback-checkpoint verification result.
findings.consequence: There is no evidence that rollback restores the recorded baseline or preserves pre-existing dirty-state files.
findings.evidence: Criterion 6 labels the commands under “Post-Rollback Verification” but gives no executed commands, timestamps, exit statuses, or captured output; it then says “Expected Result” and “procedure verified; ready to execute if rollback needed.”

findings.title: The report claims all criteria and tests passed while the independent gate is pending
findings.criterion_ref: Criterion 7: the report “does not claim completion when evidence is missing … or the independent gate has not produced a witnessed and verified `QA_PASSED` result.”
findings.trigger: The submission asserts that all six tests pass and all seven QA criteria are demonstrated even though it repeatedly records the independent gate and stop condition as pending.
findings.consequence: Downstream automation or reviewers could treat P00 as complete before the mandatory independent verification and sanctioned verify step succeed.
findings.evidence: The report states “All 6 tests pass,” marks Criterion 3 PASS, and concludes “All QA Criteria (1-7): ✓ DEMONSTRATED,” while Test 6 says the gate is being submitted, Criterion 4 shows `QA verify says QA_PASSED` as pending, and Criterion 7 records `Independent gate witness QA_PASSED?` as pending.

reasoning: The submission contains direct evidence that the initial worktree was already dirty, but it does not reconstruct the exact checkpoint delta or prove preservation. Multiple required test executions and the rollback verification are absent, and the report nevertheless makes aggregate PASS claims. These are explicit failures of criteria 2, 3, 6, and 7 and reach the stated blocker threshold.
